inputs: FP64 character-normalized complete-answer scores in identical choice order; no gold or occurrence frequencies

definitions.center: subtract arithmetic mean across this question's answer choices

limits: Choice-set-dependent score transformation, not vocabulary projection, normalized probability, calibration guarantee, or causal proof. Clipped projection need not be orthogonal. All training folds have previously been used for development; no new blind holdout. No coefficient scan.
context: Original contextual 25-shot scores and fixed Answer: auxiliary prior retained unchanged. Only these four score rules are added.
